senses.gloss: शम्पा शम्पा, f. lightning.

सम्पा सम्-पा, cl. 1. P. A. -पिबति, -ते, &c.
(see rt. 1. पा), to drink together: Caus. -पाययति,
-यितुम्, to cause to drink together, make to drink.
सम्-पश्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking at.
सम्-पश्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, beholding.

सम्पश्यमान सम्-पश्यमान. See under
1. सन्-दृश्, p. 1059, col. 3.

सम्पच् सम्-पच्, Caus. -पाचयति, -यितुम्,
to cook or mature together; to ripen thoroughly,
bake or cook thoroughly, burn.

सम्-पक्व, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly matured or
ripened.
सम्पाक सम्-पाक. See सम्-पच्, p. 1083.

सम्पठ् सम्-पठ्, cl. 1. P. -पठति, &c.,
to read through, peruse.

सम्-पाठ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to be read,
(अ-सम्पाठ्य, one with whom no one is allowed
to read.)

सम्पत् सम्-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पतितुम्,
to fly together, run or rush together, meet or come
together, flow together; to meet at (with acc.);
to unite with (with inst.); to fall together, meet
together in hostile encounter; to fly to, hasten
towards, flock to, go to, attain; to rush towards,
assail, attack; to fall in with; to fly down, fall
down, alight on; to go or roam about; to come to
pass, happen: Caus. -पातयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to fly or fall, cause to fly down, throw down, hurl
down, cast, throw.

सम्-पतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flying together, hasten-
ing together; falling or flying down, alighting,
arriving; going backwards and forwards.

सम्-पात, अस्, m. falling together, concurrence,
falling against each other, meeting together, en-
countering; butting together; general fall; falling
down, descending, coming down, alighting (as a
bird); a peculiar mode of flight (of birds); the
flight of an arrow; that which falls or settles to
the bottom, the residue (of an offering); anything
thrown in or added as an ingredient; going, moving,
removing; N. of the son of Garuḍa; (औ), m. du.,
[]
N. of two Vedic hymns.
—सम्पात-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, containing ingredients.
सम्पात सम्-पात, सम्-पाति. See सम्-पत्.

सम्-पाति, इस्, m., N. of a fabulous bird (the eldest
son of Garuḍa and elder brother of Jaṭāyu); a proper
N., (also written सं-याति.)

सम्-पत्ति, इस्, f. prosperity, success, increase of
wealth, &c., completion, fulfilment, perfection, excel-
lence; a suitable state or condition; a sort of medi-
cinal root.
सम्पातिक, अस्, m. a fabulous bird.
सम्-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, falling together.

सम्पत्नी सम्-पत्नी, f. (a woman) together
with her husband, (see पत्नी.)

सम्पद् 1. सम्-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्-
तुम्, to fall or happen well, turn out well, succeed,
be prosperous, be accomplished; be completed or
fulfilled, to become full or complete (as a number),
amount to; to become (e. g. स्वेदोद्भेदो विभूषा
सम्पेदे, the bursting out of drops of perspiration
became an ornament, Kirāt. VII. 5), be produced,
be born, be brought forth, arise; to fall together,
come together, meet with, unite with (with inst.);
to fall into any one's possession; to attain to, obtain,
acquire; to enter into, be absorbed in (with loc. or
acc.): Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to succeed,
cause to arise, cause to become, bring about, produce,
effect, accomplish complete, cause to procure, obtain,
make ready, prepare; to turn or transform into; to
furnish or provide with, endow with; to cause to
be occupied with; to attain, obtain; to be agreed,
agree upon (Ved.).

2. सम्-पद्, त्, f. success, prosperity, good fortune;
luck, fate; increase of wealth or happiness, advance-
ment of any kind, advantage, benefit, blessing; a
treasure; a necklace of pearls; decoration, adorn-
ment; accomplishment, perfection, completion; ex-
cellence; correctness, right method; excess, abun-
dance.
—सम्पद्-वसु, उस्, m., N. of one of the
seven principal rays of the sun (supposed to supply
heat to the planet Mars).
—सम्पद्-विनिमय, अस्,
m. an interchange of benefit or advantage.

सम्-पद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being accomplished,
being brought about.
सम्पद्वर, अस्, m. a king, prince.

सम्-पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen or turned out well,
successful, prosperous, fortunate, thriving, happy;
accomplished, effected, completed, finished, com-
plete, perfect; perfectly acquainted or conversant
with; full grown, mature; right, correct; procured,
acquired, obtained; possessed of, endowed with; of
perfect or correct flavour; (अस्), m. epithet of Śiva;
(अम्), n. a delicacy.
—सम्पन्न-तम, अस्, आ,
अम्, most complete or perfect.
—सम्पन्न-रूप,
अस्, आ, अम्, complete, perfect; dainty, delicate.
सम्पन्नक, अस्, आ, अम्, = सम्-पन्न above.

सम्-पाद, अस्, m. accomplishment, completion,
acquisition, obtaining.

सम्पाद सम्-पाद, सम्-पादन, &c. See
p. 1083, col. 3.

सम्पद सम्-पद, अम्, n. standing with the
feet together or even (= समम् पद-युगम्).

सम्-पादक, अस्, इका, अम्, bringing about, effect-
ing, effective of, accomplishing, fulfilling.

सम्-पादन, अस्, ई, अम्, effective of, procuring,
gaining: (अम्), n. the act of bringing about, accom-
plishing, effecting, making; preparing, clearing
(ground &c.); gaining, acquiring, reaching, attaining.

सम्-पादनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought about
or effected.

सम्-पादयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, accomplishing, effect-
ing, perfecting.

सम्-पादयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who accom-
plishes or effects.

सम्-पादित, अस्, आ, अम्, brought about, accom-
plished, effected; attained, obtained, gained, gotten.

सम्-पाद्य, ind. having procured, effected, or
obtained.

सम्परिकॄत् सम्-परि-कॄत्, cl. 10. P. -कीर्त-
यति, -यितुम्, to enumerate fully, particularise.

सम्-परिकीर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, fully enumerated,
related in detail.

सम्परिक्रम् सम्-परि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A.
-क्रामति, -क्रमते, &c., to go or walk round, to
visit in succession, go the round of.
सम्-परिक्रम्य, ind. having walked round.

सम्परिख्या सम्-परि-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति,
&c., to communicate completely, relate in full, de-
clare at length.

सम्परिग्रह् सम्-परि-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A.
-गृह्णाति, -गृह्णीते, &c., to accept fully, receive;
to receive in a friendly manner; to embrace; to
accomplish, perform, complete; to take in or under-
stand thoroughly.

सम्-परिगृह्य, ind. having accepted; having
completed, having thoroughly understood.

सम्परिचर् सम्-परि-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति,
-चरितुम्, to wait upon, attend on, serve.

सम्परिचिन्त् सम्-परि-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्-
तयति, -यितुम्, to think out, excogitate, invent.
सम्-परिचिन्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, thought out, devised.

सम्परितुष् सम्-परि-तुष्, cl. 4. P. -तुष्-
यति, -तोष्टुम्, to feel quite satisfied or content:
Caus. -तोषयति, -यितुम्, to satisfy completely,
appease.

सम्-परितोषित, अस्, आ, अम्, fully satisfied, quite
appeased.

सम्परित्यज् सम्-परि-त्यज्, cl. 1. P. -त्य-
जति, -त्यक्तुम्, to abandon completely, desert,
leave.

सम्-परित्यक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, given up.
—सम्परित्यक्त-जीवित, अस्, आ, अम्, (a battle &c.)
in which life is risked.

सम्-परित्यज्य, ind. having completely aban-
doned, having abandoned everything.

सम्परिदह् सम्-परि-दह्, Pass. -दह्यते
(also P. -ति), to be entirely burnt or consumed by
fire, be consumed.
सम्परिपॄ सम्-परि-पॄ. See rt. पॄ, p. 596.

सम्-परिपूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, quite filled, fully
satisfied; completely accomplished, perfected.
—सम्-
परिपूर्ण-विद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, well filled with
knowledge, perfect in knowledge.

सम्परिप्लु सम्-परि-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते,
&c., to flow quite over, overflow completely.

सम्-परिप्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, completely overflowed,
deluged; overwhelmed (with misfortune &c.), greatly
distressed.

सम्परिभू सम्-परि-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति,
&c., to despise or contemn utterly: Pass. -भूयते,
to be despised, &c.: Caus. -भावयति, -यितुम्, to
fix firmly, hold well together, control.
सम्परिभ्रंश् सम्-परि-भ्रंश्. See rt. भ्रंश्.

सम्-परिभ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen away from,
entirely deprived of (with abl.).

सम्परिमुद् सम्-परि-मुद्, cl. 1. A. -मोदते,
&c., to rejoice greatly, exult.

सम्परिरक्ष् सम्-परि-रक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -रक्-
षति, -रक्षितुम्, to keep complete guard over,
protect, defend.

सम्परिरभ् सम्-परि-रभ्, cl. 1. A. -रभते,
&c., to take well hold of; to clasp or embrace mutually.
सम्-परिरभ्य, ind. having mutually embraced.

सम्परिवृ सम्-परि-वृ, cl. 5. P. A. -वृणोति,
वृणुते, &c., to surround completely, encompass,
encircle: Caus. -वारयति, &c., to surround.

सम्-परिवारित, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely surrounded
or encompassed.

सम्-परिवार्य, ind. having encircled or encom-
passed.

सम्-परिवृत, अस्, आ, अम् (Ved. also सम्-परी-
वृत), completely surrounded.

सम्परिवृज् सम्-परि-वृज्, Caus. -वर्जयति,
-यितुम्, to shun or avoid utterly, forsake, abandon.

सम्परिवृत् सम्-परि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते,
&c., to turn completely round, roll round, revolve;
to exist; to turn back, return; to turn back from,
desist from (with abl.): Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to turn round, lead round, lead about.

सम्-परिवर्त्य, ind. having made to turn round,
having led round.

सम्परिशोषण सम्-परिशोषण, अम्, n. (fr.
rt. शुष् with परि and सम्), becoming completely
dried up, withering up, emaciation.
सम्परिष्वञ्ज् सम्-परि-ष्वञ्ज्. See rt. स्वञ्ज्.

सम्-परिष्वक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, mutually embraced,
closely embraced.
सम्-परिष्वज्य, ind. having mutually embraced.

सम्परिहृष् सम्-परि-हृष्, Caus. -हर्ष-
यति, -यितुम्, to make completely happy, delight.

सम्परे सम्-परे (-परा-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl.
2. P. -परैति, &c., to come together (in conflict);
to go away, go beyond (especially to another world
or future state).

सम्-पराय, अस्, m. meeting together in strife
or encounter, conflict, contention, war, battle;
calamity, adversity; the other world, a future state,
futurity, future time; a son.

साम्पराय साम्पराय, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. सम्-
पराय), relating to war or battle, warlike; relating
to the other world or a future state, belonging to the
future; (अस्, अम्), m. n. contention, conflict; the
future, future life; means of attaining a future world;
inquiry into the future; investigation (in general);
uncertainty.

सम्परायक, अम्, n. conflict, encounter, war,
battle.
सम्परायिक, अम्, n. = सम्परायक above.

साम्परायिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to war, military,
strategic; warlike; calamitous; relating to the other
world or a future state, belonging to future time,
future; (अस्), m. a war-chariot; (अम्), n. war, battle.
—साम्परायिक-कल्प, अस्, m. military form, strategic
array.
सम्पर्क सम्-पर्क. See under सम्-पृच्.

सम्पर्याप् सम्-पर्य्-आप् (-परि-आप्), cl. 5. P.
-आप्नोति, &c., Ved. to take hold of together.

सम्-पर्याप्य, ind. having taken hold of simul-
taneously.

सम्पलाय् सम्-पलाय् (fr. rt. अय् = rt. 5. इ
with पला for परा and सम्), cl. 1. A. -पलायते,
-यितुम्, to run away together, escape.
सम्-पाय, ind. having drunk together.

सम्-पीति, इस्, f. drinking in company, compo-
tation.
सम्पीति सम्-पीति. See under सम्-पा.

सम्पाट सम्-पाट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पट् with
सम्), a spindle; the intersection of the prolonged
side of a triangle by a perpendicular.
सम्पार सम्पार, अस्, m. a proper N.
सम्पारण सम्-पारण. See सम्-पॄ, col. 3.

सम्-पारण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. (equally referrible
to सम्-पृ above), completing, filling, adequate,
(Sāy. = इच्छायाः सम्यक् पूरक, Ṛg-veda III.
45, 4.)

सम्पिण्ड् सम्-पिण्ड्, cl. 10. P. -पिण्डयति, &c.,
to heap together; to clench.

सम्-पिण्डित, अस्, आ, अम्, heaped together; con-
tracted.
—सम्पिण्डिताङ्गुलि (˚त-अङ्˚), इस्, इस्, इ,
having the fingers clenched or closed.

सम्पिष् सम्-पिष्, cl. 7. P. -पिनष्टि (Impf.
सम्-अपिनट्, Ved. सम्-पिणक्), -पेष्टुम्, to grind
or rub together, pound or crush to pieces, bruise,
crush (Soma &c.); to shatter, destroy, kill.

सम्-पिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, crushed or broken to
pieces, pounded, bruised, shattered, destroyed.

सम्-पेषण, अम्, n. the act of grinding toge-
ther, pounding.

सम्पीड् सम्-पीड्, cl. 10. P. -पीडयति, -यि-
तुम्, to compress, press or squeeze together, oppress,
[]
press, force; to pinch, pain, torture, vex, harass.
disturb; to obscure, eclipse; to reckon up, calculate
together, compute, sum up.

सम्-पीड, अस्, m. pressing or squeezing together,
pain, torture; harassing, agitating, disturbing; send-
ing, directing; (आ), f. torment.

सम्-पीडन, अम्, n. compression, pressing toge-
ther, squeezing; pinching, paining, castigation, punish-
ment; stirring together, agitating; sending.

सम्-पीडयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, compressing; squeez-
ing, tormenting, paining.

सम्-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed together, squeezed;
pained, tortured, punished; agitated; sent.

सम्-पीड्य, ind. having pressed together, having
tormented; having restrained.

सम्पुट सम्-पुट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पुट् with
सम्), a covered box, casket; the Kuruvaka flower.

सम्पुटक, अस्, m. a box, casket; (इका), f. a
box filled with ornaments.

सम्पुष् सम्-पुष्, cl. 9. P. -पुष्णाति, -पो-
षितुम्, to become thoroughly nourished, increase,
grow.

सम्-पोष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be well nourished or
supported.

सम्पू सम्-पू, cl. 9. P. A. -पुनाति, -पुनीते,
&c., to cleanse thoroughly, purify: Caus. -पावयति,
-यितुम्, to make clean, cleanse, purify.
सम्-पूय, ind. having cleansed, having purified.

सम्पूज् सम्-पूज्, cl. 10. P. -पूजयति, -यितुम्,
to honour greatly, esteem or value highly.

सम्-पूजन, अम्, n. the act of treating with great
respect, honouring, reverence, esteem.

सम्-पूजनीय or सम्-पूजयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
to be highly honoured or valued; to be respected.

सम्-पूजित, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly honoured, highly
respected or valued, revered.
1. सम्-पूज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be honoured, &c.

2. सम्-पूज्य, ind. having honoured, honouring,
worshipping, paying respect to.

सम्पृ सम्-पृ, Caus. -पारयति, -यितुम्,
Ved. to bring over to the further side, bring to an
end, accomplish, perform.

सम्पॄ सम्-पॄ, Pass. -पूर्यते, to be com-
pletely filled, become quite full: Caus. -पारयति,
पूरयति, -यितुम्, to make quite full, complete;
to fill with.

सम्पृच् सम्-पृच्, cl. 7. P. -पृणक्ति (also
apparently cl. 3. in some Vedic forms, e. g. सम्-
पिपृग्धि, -पिपृक्त, &c.), cl. 2. A. -पृक्ते or
-पृङ्क्ते, &c. (see rt. 1. पृच्), to mix together,
commingle, bring into contact, connect, unite; to
be mixed together, be united, be in contact, be
connected (A.); to fill up, fill, complete; to fill or
satiate with, present with; to be filled or satiated
with, be presented with (A.).

सम्पर्किन्, ई, इणी, इ, blended together, mixed;
united with, connected; in contact with, touching.

सम्पर्कीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to contact or
connection; liable to come in contact.

सम्-पृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed together, blended,
combined, conjoined, united, connected, related; in
contact with, touching, in close contact; interspersed,
inlaid.

सम्-पृञ्चान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being mixed or
mingled with, associated with.

सम्-पूरयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to be full,
filling.
सम्-पूरित, अस्, आ, अम्, filled quite full, filled with.

सम्-पूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, completely filled or full,
replete; full (as the moon); complete, finished;
whole, entire; (अस्), m. any mode of music in which
all the notes of the gamut are employed; (आ), f.
a particular एकादशी, q. v.; (अम्), n. ether, the
etherial element or atmosphere.
—सम्पूर्ण-काम,
अस्, आ, अम्, filled with desire.
—सम्पूर्ण-तर,
अस्, आ, अम्, more filled, very full.
—सम्पूर्ण-ता,
f. or सम्पूर्ण-त्व, अम्, n. complete fulness, per-
fection, completeness.
—सम्पूर्ण-विद्य, अस्, आ,
अम्, replete with knowledge.

सम्प्रकम्प् सम्-प्र-कम्प्, cl. 1. A. -कम्-
पते, -कम्पितुम्, to tremble violently, shiver,
quake: Caus. -कम्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
tremble.

सम्प्रकाश् सम्-प्र-काश्, cl. 1. A. -काशते,
&c., to become manifest, be visible, appear; to
shine, glitter: Caus. -काशयति, -यितुम्, to illumi-
nate, make manifest, display, discover, disclose.

सम्-प्रकाशित, अस्, आ, अम्, made manifest, dis-
played, discovered.

सम्प्रकृ सम्-प्र-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति,
-कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to perform, practise, do; to effect,
render, cause anything to become (with two acc.).
सम्प्रकॄ सम्-प्र-कॄ, See rt. 1. कॄ.

सम्प्रकृष् सम्-प्र-कृष्, cl. 1. P. -कर्षति,
&c., to drag along with, carry off, tear away.

सम्-प्रकीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly mixed or
mingled.

-प्रोर्णोति or -प्रोर्णौति, -प्रोर्णुते, &c., to cover
all over, cover completely.

सम्प्लु सम्-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लोतुम्,
to flow together; to float about; to fluctuate: Caus.
-प्लावयति, -यितुम्, to inundate, flood over, sub-
merge, overwhelm; to cause to float about.

सम्-प्लवमान, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing together,
floating about, &c.

सम्-प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, flooded, overspread, over-
cast.
—सम्प्लुतोदक (˚त-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, flooded
with water.

साम्पश्य साम्पश्य, अस्, &c. (fr. rt. 1. पश्
with सम्), Ved. causing mutual looks (of love),
forcing mutual glances (of affection; said of a herb
used in charms or philters).

साम्प्रतम् साम्प्रतम्, ind. (fr. सम्-प्रति),
now, at this time; seasonably, fitly, properly; [cf. अ-स्˚.]

साम्प्रतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the present
time, present (not future), suitable to the present
occasion, suitable.

साम्प्रदायिक साम्प्रदायिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr.
सम्-प्रदाय), traditional, belonging to traditional
doctrine, handed down by tradition.

साम्प्रयोगिक साम्प्रयोगिक, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr.
सम्-प्रयोग), relating to sexual union.
